sentences.text: This synthetic document describes the Pb–Sn binary system as calculated with pycalphad from the SGTE dataset PbSn-17Gie.tdb; every figure, table and stated value is generated, and the exact values are kept in a separate truth key.
The highest invariant reaction, L → (Pb) + (Sn), lies at 182.7 °C.
The Pb–Sn system belongs to the 20 binaries of the ORCHID benchmark, chosen to cover diagram types such as simple eutectic.
The thermodynamic description is the SGTE collection entry (Hallstedt, 2025), which reproduces the assessment of W. Gierlotka, Y.-C. Tung, J. Phase Equilib. Diffus., 38, 814-28(2017).
The calculations use pycalphad 0.11.2 at 1 atm.
For Sn, the liquidus meets the axis at 231.9 °C.
At 182.7 °C the eutectic L → (Pb) + (Sn) takes place; the L phase then contains 74.5 at.%.
At 700 K the integral mixing enthalpy of the liquid has its maximum, 1.29 kJ/mol, at 48.0 at.% Sn.
This document is synthetic and exists only to test extraction tools; its truth key lists every boundary, field, invariant, plotted point, table cell and stated value.
